scope: Exploratory on exposed 2023, 2024, 2025 cohorts. Freeze before accessing benchmark test results. Newly authorized CURRENT pointer on this branch; preserve prior bytes. Main endpoint cause1 12 calendar months.
main: C039 seeds 17/503/22 equally weighted 32-tree shrunk archived members; 74 inputs; q2 depth4 support guard2 parent AJ10. No new main-model fit, reshrinkage or calibration.
clock: Exactly the main model training company snapshots at Jan 1; next trading day pre-open origin; 24-calendar-month training cap; cause1 prior final termination, cause2 prior recovery. Censor at available stop. Same individual calendar day horizons 365/366 and 730/731. 2025 H24 predictions/diagnostics only, performance NA.

arms.AJ: Training-only pooled AJ, no tunable parameters.
arms.FG: Separate cause-specific Fine–Gray proportional subdistribution hazard models. IPCW marginal censoring KM of fit sample, Breslow ties. Ridge partial loglikelihood averaged per observed event. Lambda {0.01,0.1,1}; common lambda both causes. Report possible cross-cause incoherence without clipping or normalizing.
arms.CSC: Two ridge cause-specific Cox hazards, same lambda grid and objective scaling, Breslow and joint product integration using 1-exp(-sum hazard increment).
arms.RF: randomForestSRC logrankCR, equal cause weights, 32 trees per seed, sample companies with replacement using original bootstrap, mtry=floor(sqrt(effective feature count)) at least1, nsplit10, unrestricted depth, nodesize {5,10,20}. Internal single fixed seed 7301; same chosen nodesize for all six outer seeds.
arms.unrestricted: Same-backend matched ForestConfig from main, change only path_budget=None; no tuning, same bootstrap/variable pools and parent AJ10. Full higher-order representation where present.
arms.KNN_AJ: Additional deterministic nonparametric local constant survival benchmark. Euclidean train-standardized predictors, k-nearest firms followed by local AJ; k={20,50,100} capped at available n, ties by original training row. Captures local nonlinear patterns without trees. Forecasts estimated from the same train labels.

preprocess: Linear and KNN use fit-only column medians (0 for entirely missing) and missing flags for columns with both observed and missing training values, then training population standardization; drop exact constants. RF uses same imputations and flags, no need to standardize. Custom forests native NA.
tuning: Two forward entry cohorts Y-3,Y-2. Rebuild each fit from outer training companies with origin before inner Jan 1, stop/censor strictly before that boundary, no future events. Evaluate only using outcomes known by outer cutoff. Validation loss = equal-weight mean of both 12m IPCW Briers across supported folds and causes. Common lambda across causes; tie tolerance 1e-12 prefer greater lambda/larger node/larger k. If no usable fold predeclared middle grid; report invalid fit, unknown, failure. No outer result selection.
seeds: Both 17/503/22 and 42/101/202 for each random model, report each seed and averages of individual predictions. 120 overlapping archived XAI triples: metric medians, P05/P95. Median is recomputed across triple metrics within each bootstrap, never a single model, nor median prediction. Compare C039 and median to both benchmark ensembles separately; supplements original-seed anchor.
metrics: Same repository annual evaluator. Supported years and pooled across supported years. Report both causes: annual AUC/AP/IPCW Brier, within-year pairs weighted AUC, annual ceil(.2n) Top20 tie on sample id, captures/coverage, mean probability, observed CIF rate, O/E and predicted minus observed. At all supported outer windows verify weights=1. Report calibration and ranking separately.
bootstrap: 1000 fixed-prediction company draws stratified by test year, analysis seed 2026110201, verify original stored indices. Paired primary and secondary differences, percentile intervals, counts of undefined draws; pooled averages not averages of yearly metrics. Fixed training/weights/choices; does not correct C039 selection bias.
index: Risk index v2 b5a0e438ff4133a12ff747eb18f1789db7448df8: denominator own trained product-marginal mu at 365/730. Individual calendar horizons. Training OOB predictions across all eligible original trees at fixed days, >=10 trees & >=30 companies. Linear q50/q80, ties to upper tier. Verify inbag counts, exact points, inverse, ranking and matched annual metrics. No model fitted, no probability update. Withhold small tier counts and complements as v2.
complexity: Actual nonzero main, pair, higher-order functions for native ensembles with time/causes combined; also seeds when available. Otherwise distinguish link-scale terms, baseline curves, leaves, reference rows and unavailable CIF representation. Elapsed fit/predict or end-to-end CPU task seconds, actual placement; no historical time presented as new training.
privacy: Private company-level inputs, fits, individual forecasts, thresholds and mu. Aggregate public evidence only. 2025H24 stays NA. Record failures, divergences and joint probability checks; no clipping.
